ppf.name: Paint Protection Film
ppf.benefit: A clear shield that takes the hit instead of your paint
ppf.problem: Road gravel, sand, keys, and half-centimetre accidents all mark the original paint — and every scratch takes money off your resale price.
ppf.solutionIntro: Japanese TAKAI film sits over the paint and absorbs the damage instead:

solutions.b1: Self-healing material — light scratches disappear with heat
solutions.b2: Full clarity, zero change to the original colour
solutions.b3: Protection against sun yellowing and chemical rain
solutions.b4: Removes cleanly whenever you choose, paint untouched

warranty.label: Warranty
warranty.value: Standard tiers: up to 15 years · Premium Plus: lifetime*

selfHealing.label: Self-healing
selfHealing.value: 15 μm self-healing coating on every tier

1.q: Will the film show on the car?
1.a: No. TAKAI film is fully transparent and follows the paint's own surface. What shows is the gloss.

2.a: One to three days depending on coverage. Full body takes its time — done properly.

3.q: Can I wash the car normally?
3.a: A week after installation, wash as usual. Steam and foam are both fine.

4.a: Thickness, warranty years, and self-healing level. Each tier has its warranty in writing, under its own name.

5.a: Self-healing handles surface scratches. Deep cuts are fixed by replacing that panel's film only.

6.q: What if I sell the car?
6.a: The warranty transfers with the car to the new owner for its remaining term — it follows the car, not the owner.

solutions.b3: Protects upholstery and dashboard from cracking and fading

3.a: The shades we recommend are balanced: high rejection without driving in a tunnel.

nano-ceramic.name: Nano Ceramic
nano-ceramic.benefit: Deep gloss and a surface that repels water and dust
nano-ceramic.problem: Washing, sun, rain — the paint surface tires and dulls, and swirl marks build up over time.
nano-ceramic.solutionIntro: A ceramic layer bonds chemically with the paint and gives you:

solutions.b1: Deep gloss that lasts months, not weeks
solutions.b2: Hydrophobic surface — dust and mud don't stick

withPpf.name: Over PPF
withPpf.coverage: Ceramic on top of protection film

1.q: How is it different from wax?
1.a: Wax sits for weeks. Ceramic bonds with the paint itself and stays for months and years.

2.a: It reduces light marks. Real impact protection comes from PPF.

3.q: How do I wash the car after?
3.a: Hand wash or steam — and stay away from harsh brushes.

4.a: One to two days depending on paint condition — the prep and polish before coating matter most.

5.a: Yes — the strongest combination: film takes the impact, ceramic makes cleaning easy.

building-heat-isolation.name: Building heat isolation
building-heat-isolation.benefit: Less sun, lower bills — without darkening the glass
building-heat-isolation.imageAlt: Placeholder — building installation photography is being documented
building-heat-isolation.seoTitle: Building Window Film & Heat Isolation | SupaKoto
building-heat-isolation.seoDescription: TAKAI TK-7099-IR Japanese window film for buildings and glass facades in Egypt and the UAE. 99% infrared rejection at 70% clarity — offices, apartments and villas. Send your measurements for a quote, no site visit needed.
building-heat-isolation.problem: Sun pours through the glass all day. The AC fights it and loses, the bill climbs, screens catch the glare, and furniture and floors fade a little more every month. The usual fixes — closed curtains or dark glass — cost you the light and the view.
building-heat-isolation.solutionIntro: One film, applied to the glass, that solves it without changing how the building looks:

solutions.b1: Rejects 99% of infrared — the main heat carrier — so the AC works less and the bill drops
solutions.b2: Blocks 99.5% of the UV that fades furniture, curtains and flooring
solutions.b3: Cuts screen glare while the glass stays 70% clear — daylight and view intact
solutions.b4: Holds shattered glass together so fragments don't scatter — safer for everyone inside

building-heat-isolation.positioning: Darker films score higher total heat rejection — we fit those on cars. For buildings we chose the TK-7099-IR for one reason: the highest heat rejection you can get while the glass still looks untouched. If you want a cooler space without giving up light and view, this is it.

product.label: Product
product.value: TAKAI TK-7099-IR — UV nano ceramic, Premium IR series

funnel.s1: Call us or send a quote request from the site

1.q: How do I measure if I'm not a professional?
1.a: Measure each window or glass wall (width × height, in metres), or estimate the total area in square metres. It doesn't need to be exact — the technician re-checks every measurement on site before installation.

2.q: Do you need to visit before I get a price?
2.a: No. We quote on the measurements you send; the actual check happens on installation day.

3.a: A typical apartment or office is done in a day. Large facades can take longer — the expected duration is stated in your quote.

4.q: What if the on-site measurements differ from what I sent?
4.a: The final price is adjusted to the actual measurement before any work starts — no surprises after installation.

whoWeAre.title: Our story
whoWeAre.body: We started in 2016 out of a genuine love of cars and a conviction that this market deserved a different level of protection. We secured a Japanese film made exclusively for us — TAKAI — and built workshops around it to the factory's own standard: measurement before any work, documented installation at every step. The journey hasn't stopped since — partnerships with Škoda, Kasrawy and Mansour, branches from Maadi to the Fifth Settlement and from Alexandria to Dubai, past 25,000 cars protected. These are the milestones:

vision.title: Vision
vision.body: To be the Middle East's reference in car protection — the first name that comes to mind when you think of protecting your investment.

mission.title: Mission
mission.body: Deliver the finest Japanese material with the finest installation, and keep the experience transparent: clear pricing, written warranty, visible results.

values.title: Values
values.body: Precision before speed. Honesty before the sale. Every car in our workshop is treated like our own.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.sub: What gets asked most — answered straight

whatIsPpf.a: A transparent TPU layer installed over the paint that takes scratches and gravel instead — and removes without a trace.

whyJapanese.a: Colour stability, adhesive quality, and self-healing. TAKAI is made in Japan to specifications we set.

howLongInstall.a: By service: isolation half a day to a day, film one to three days, ceramic one to two days.

bookingDeposit.a: We confirm those details in the booking confirmation call — it varies by service and branch.

whichBranch.a: The nearest — every branch runs the same standards and the same material. See the branches page.

warrantyTiers.q: Why isn't there one warranty number?
warrantyTiers.a: Because warranty follows the protection tier. Each tier has its term and conditions in writing, under its own name — cleaner than a vague blanket promise.

warrantyVoid.a: Outside work on the film, accidents, or clear misuse. Details are in your tier's booklet.

warrantyTransfer.q: Does warranty transfer if I sell?
warrantyTransfer.a: Yes — the warranty follows the car, not the owner, and passes to the buyer for its remaining term.

washAfter.q: When can I wash after installation?
washAfter.a: Wait a week, then wash normally — hand or steam beats automatic brushes.

selfHealing.a: Sun heat or warm water makes surface scratches in the film disappear on their own.

bhiMeasure.q: How do I measure if I'm not a professional?
bhiMeasure.a: Measure each window or glass wall (width × height, in metres), or estimate the total area in square metres. It doesn't need to be exact — the technician re-checks every measurement on site before installation.

bhiVisit.q: Do you need to visit before I get a price?
bhiVisit.a: No. We quote on the measurements you send; the actual check happens on installation day.

bhiDuration.a: A typical apartment or office is done in a day. Large facades can take longer — the expected duration is stated in your quote.

bhiMismatch.q: What if the on-site measurements differ from what I sent?
bhiMismatch.a: The final price is adjusted to the actual measurement before any work starts — no surprises after installation.
